reviews.author: Derick Chargoy
reviews.quote_html: "Got a compass tattoo on my neck Jan 2024. My artist, Jake, did an amazing job, not only with the quality of my tattoo but he also ensured proper hygiene. Even with the location of my tattoo, I fell asleep on the table. The shop is clean and welcoming. Definitely recommend and will be going back!!"
flags: Explicit January 2024 experience.

reviews.author: Tog Games
reviews.quote_html: "Got a Helix piercings and nipple piercings done. Shop was clean and everything was in sterile packaging. The owner did both my piercings and he didn't make it awkward or anything was super helpful—gave me a lollipop during the first piercings and let me take one for the road. Pricing was reasonable! About 50 bucks per piercing roughly—this shop is cash only though but they have an ATM next door if you forget cash. Was able to sketch up a tattoo idea I've had for years and given an estimate on the spot—will 100% be back."
flags: Historical cash-only and price statements; do not select for current sales copy.

reviews.author: Kyler McKay
reviews.quote_html: "Jake is the all time best—he cares so much about your well being while getting the tattoo and also is an amazing artist. Highly recommend—definitely coming back for more!"

reviews.author: Janeil Leitch
reviews.quote_html: "Love Sideshow Productions—it's like a home away from home and everyone is so friendly and helpful. Would recommend this place to any and everybody!!"

reviews.author: Leisl Fuentes
reviews.quote_html: "Came for an event today for a great cause and got my teeth whitened and a lovely heart tattoo! The whole staff was so kind and welcoming! Please consider them for all your piercing, teeth whitening, teeth gem and tattoo needs ❤️"

reviews.author: Jennifer Sanchez
reviews.quote_html: "I love Sideshow Productions! They have the best flash events and great custom work. They're super friendly and the environment is very comfortable. I love that they have snacks and drinks for sale (it's never good to get tattooed on an empty tummy)."

reviews.author: Drista Ricord
reviews.quote_html: "Coming in, it was very welcoming. I’ve gotten a couple tattoos here before and I love this place. My artist was Jake and he had amazing lines. The tattoo looked exactly like the handwriting I wanted it in."

reviews.author: Brittni Bidwell
reviews.quote_html: "I love this tattoo shop and the people here. I’ve gotten so many great tattoos and I can’t wait to get more. Jake is so amazing and so patient—I love how he takes his time with my tattoos; they always come out so amazing and looking so beautiful. Thank you for the great experience. I can’t wait for more of your art."

reviews.author: Hayley Ainsworth
reviews.quote_html: "Had a tattoo with Jake and it was the BEST tattoo experience I have ever had. Most painless tattoo EVER. I almost fell asleep (in a good way lol). They're healing super well. Was given a second piece of second skin to apply later if it peeled and was wrapped up super well before leaving. Clean shop. Felt comfortable from the start of my appointment."
flags: Describes pain and care outcomes as this customer’s experience; do not convert to a business guarantee.

reviews.author: Mikka Jacobson
reviews.quote_html: "Super welcoming group of artists! I had tiny finger tattoos done and they gave me all the information I needed to prepare myself for finger/hand tattoos. Katie did an amazing job with my simple little tats! Can’t wait to get my next tats here!"
flags: Names Katie, outside currently verified four-person roster.

reviews.author: Ashleigh Jensen
reviews.quote_html: "I absolutely loveeeeee this tattoo shop!! I have gotten my last 3 tattoos from them and my dad has gotten one as well. Everyone has been super nice and the environment is very welcoming! Every artist there does amazing work and they are very accommodating. Highly recommend this shop for your next tattoo!"

reviews.author: Jae Ahlstrom
reviews.quote_html: "He pierced my nose for me! Was super nice and professional! I absolutely love Sideshow! They are nice every time I've come in!"

reviews.author: grey
reviews.quote_html: "I went and got a few piercings from Sonny for some promotion. All the employees were really nice and supportive, and I ended up having a conversation with several of them. I plan on coming back again."

reviews.author: Megan Yama
reviews.quote_html: "AMAZING people! So far the best experience I’ve had since I’ve been in Utah. I like the energy and people."

reviews.author: Leah Lee
reviews.quote_html: "I LOVE THIS PLACE!! Katie is such an amazing artist and everyone here is so nice and very welcoming. I’ve gotten two tattoos from Katie and they have come out stunning. I would highly recommend her or any of the artists here for any tattoo you might want. They have fair prices too!!"
flags: Names Katie, outside currently verified four-person roster.

reviews.author: Helen Barbosa
reviews.quote_html: "Love this place. My daughter and I have gotten a few flash tattoos and have never been disappointed."

reviews.author: Ken Crick
reviews.quote_html: "Great location and crew. Katie did a design my daughter drew and I am going back for more."
flags: Names Katie, outside currently verified four-person roster.

reviews.author: Sandy Howard
reviews.quote_html: "Staff is fantastic, great quality of work and fast. I have gotten tattoos from two different artists here and they were both excellent. Schedule is a little tight, so plan ahead—but I love this place and will continue to recommend it to others."

reviews.author: Alexia Henrie
reviews.quote_html: "I absolutely adore this tattoo shop! It's clean and friendly. Everyone is super kind and amazing, but super special shout out to Maddie! She is the artist who did this lovely piece! Super great experience!"
flags: Names Maddie, outside currently verified four-person roster.

about_html:
‎ ‎

‎

Sideshow Productions: Your trusted tattoo shop founded in 2020

Tattoo shop located in Murray, Utah offering tattoos, piercings, teeth whitening, tooth gems and other services.

We have given to numerous nonprofit organizations, including:
Breast Cancer Research Foundation, Brighton Recovery,
Fit To Recover, Humane Society of Utah, and Toys for Tots.

We offer a clean, sterile, friendly environment for our clients and artists.

Great vibes. Come check us out!

‎

Our Journey:

  • Customer Trust: Our commitment to honesty and quality service has earned us a spot in everyone's hearts (and skin lol)
  • High Ratings: With over 213 reviews and an impressive 4.6 star average rating, our reputation speaks for itself.
  • Community Engagement: Our active participation and donations to various nonprofit organizations reflect our dedication to the community's well-being and our belief in giving back.

‎ ‎

Our Promises:

  • Expertise and Quality: Every artist at Sideshow Productions is selected for their exceptional skill and dedication to craft, using only the highest quality materials to ensure your art is not just safe but lasts a lifetime.
  • Privacy and Confidentiality: We guarantee the utmost discretion with your designs and personal information, offering secure data handling and the option for private sessions to meet your comfort level.
  • Healthy and Safe Environment: Our commitment to your well-being is reflected in our rigorous sterilization protocols, continuous staff training on health and safety, and a client-first approach that ensures a clean, welcoming space for all.
